evidence: The solid MeCpPtMe3 precursor (99%, Strem Chemicals), kept in a stainless steel container, was heated above its melting point (30 °C), and the delivery line to the chamber was heated to 60 °C. Argon was used as a carrier gas for the Pt precursor. O3 was produced from a pure O2 flow with an OzoneLab OL100 ozone generator, resulting in an O3 concentration of 175 μg/mL.
